name: at-file-ref-grammar
opens_with: typing '@' at a word boundary in the composer

nondeterminism.reason: The @ popup's CONTENT is working-directory dependent: the async fuzzy tier is sim-deterministic-disabled (maybe_spawn_file_suggest gates on is_simulating), so what the popup lists depends on the checkout that runs it, and the golden would differ between the CI clone and a developer's tree with untracked scratch files.
nondeterminism.varying_region: The suggestion rows themselves (which entries the listing found); the composer field and the overlay frame are stable.
nondeterminism.surface_of_fix: Seed the file-discovery scan with a pinned fixture root under OPERANT_SIM_FIXTURE_DIR (the corpus's existing pinning shape) so the listing is identical everywhere. Until then the grammar's HONEST oracle is the unit layer, which already pins it: prompt_input/tests.rs file_ref_value_grammar_shapes, accept_file_ref_appends_space_and_uses_grammar, accepted_file_ref_token_injects_via_context_references.

notes: Plan 2026-10-24 M4: the @ popup shares the slash-command palette. The grammar shape (values are @file:/@folder: tokens) is pinned by unit tests in prompt_input/tests.rs (file_ref_value_grammar_shapes, accept_file_ref_appends_space_and_uses_grammar, accepted_file_ref_token_injects_via_context_references) — the async fuzzy tier is sim-deterministic-disabled (maybe_spawn_file_suggest gates on is_simulating), so the live popup contents depend on the working directory; the unit layer is the honest oracle for the grammar. RT-180/196 correction (2026-10-26): this scenario was never executable — it carried an illegal `<text>` key token, asserted a `prompt_input.suggestions_source_file_ref` field debug_snapshot() has never exposed, and had no baseline keys (which killed `_run.py verify` as a bare KeyError for the whole corpus). It now carries the three optional keys, the legal `@cr` key sequence, and the honest assertions: the composer keeps focus and shows the typed token. The popup's own contents stay with the unit layer, which is where they were already pinned.
